facts.business: Lasa Supergenerics Limited is engaged in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceutical products, holding patents for various active pharmaceutical ingredients and processes.

auditor.name: Gupta Rustagi & Co Chartered Accountant
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Inability to determine completeness and accuracy of financial impact from fire incident on May 18, 2025, including impairment of tangible assets (provisional Rs 700 Lacs recognized, final assessment pending). 2) No impairment assessment carried out for intangible assets (Patents, Goodwill, Software) aggregating Rs 1667.05 Lacs despite indicators of impairment. Emphasis of Matter on: write-off of CWIP Rs 46.27 Lakhs; fire incident with assets not insured and loss yet to be estimated; GST mismatches and demand orders of Rs 3588.64 lakhs contested by company.

key_risks: Fire incident on May 18, 2025 causing damage to factory plant, inventory, and assets with assets not covered by insurance and financial loss yet to be fully estimated
Impairment uncertainty for tangible assets (provisional Rs 700 Lacs recognized, final assessment pending)
Impairment uncertainty for intangible assets (Patents, Goodwill, Software) aggregating Rs 1667.05 Lacs with no impairment assessment performed
GST compliance issues including mismatches between books and returns, pending adjustment entries, and demand orders of Rs 3588.64 lakhs under appeal
